name: claude-config-viewer
description: Minimal local UI to visualize the entire Claude Code configuration (~/.claude)

scripts.install:deps: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:server: cd server && npx tsx watch src/index.ts
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
